name: Driftglass
description: Personal intelligence for standing questions: chosen sources become developing Stories, current cited answers, connected memory, decisions, forecasts, Intelligence Packs, and one workspace per Mission.
skills: continuously collect useful public sources with optional signed-in sources through the Companion
collapse repeated coverage into evolving Stories and distinguish origin, independent corroboration, same-family repetition, echoes, and updates
operate standing Research Missions with expected events, durable Workflows, one Cloudflare Computer per Mission, and deterministic Intelligence Routines
maintain connected memory over time with a visible source trail, contradictions, expectations, decisions, and approved changes
prepare fixed, hashed evidence snapshots so ChatGPT, Claude, Grok, or another capable model can reason over the same traceable evidence
compare subscription-model results without introducing a mandatory model API or hidden autonomous model loop
record decisions, forecasts, reviews, outcomes, and calibration
score source independence and usefulness, then adapt collection cadence without exceeding the selected application budget
apply Pack updates over local overlays and surface conflicts for a choice
publish evidence-linked pages, downloadable copies, forkable Packs, Agent Skills, and model-ready evidence briefs

reasoning_surfaces.chatgpt: Driftglass plugin and OAuth MCP, Scheduled Tasks over focused packets, exact evidence snapshots, and Deep Research handoffs for broad source expansion.
reasoning_surfaces.claude: Compact remote MCP, Agent Skill, exact Markdown/JSON evidence snapshots, and optional local Mission workspace access through Claude Code.
reasoning_surfaces.grok: Exact evidence snapshots and compact MCP where supported; Driftglass does not depend on consumer-site automation.
reasoning_surfaces.generic: Compact MCP or a hashed Markdown/JSON evidence snapshot with an evidence check, source trail, and requested answer shape.

interface_policy: Use Research for Today, Missions, Stories, sources, and memory. Connect Allow updates when the user wants to save an answer, decision, Pack change, Computer note, or memory proposal.
